# Reusable skills

These entries help agents reuse established boundaries and patterns instead of inventing new ones.

## Decision Record

| Entry | Purpose | Status |
|---|---|---|

| [Factory or Direct Construction](decision-factory-vs-direct-construction.md) | Choose a factory only when object selection or coordinated construction policy should be hidden from callers. | `stable` |

## Design Pattern

| Entry | Purpose | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [Adapter](pattern-adapter.md) | Translate an external or incompatible interface into a boundary owned by the consuming system. | `stable` |
| [Builder](pattern-builder.md) | Construct a complex value through readable, validated steps while keeping invalid intermediate state controlled. | `stable` |
| [Command](pattern-command.md) | Represent an action as data so execution, queuing, auditing, retries, or undo can be handled explicitly. | `stable` |
| [Dependency Injection](pattern-dependency-injection.md) | Supply collaborators explicitly at construction or call boundaries so lifecycle and substitution remain visible. | `stable` |
| [Factory](pattern-factory.md) | Centralise object selection or construction policy when callers should not know concrete creation details. | `stable` |
| [Repository](pattern-repository.md) | Expose persistence operations in domain terms while isolating storage protocols and mapping. | `stable` |
| [State Machine](pattern-state-machine.md) | Model allowed states, events, guards, and transitions explicitly when lifecycle behaviour is non-trivial. | `stable` |
| [Strategy](pattern-strategy.md) | Encapsulate a real algorithm or policy variation behind an explicit interchangeable contract. | `stable` |
| [Visitor](pattern-visitor.md) | Add operations across a stable heterogeneous structure without distributing each operation across every element type. | `stable` |

## Shared Component

| Entry | Purpose | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [Caching Boundary](component-caching.md) | Make cache keys, freshness, invalidation, ownership, and failure behaviour explicit at a stable boundary. | `stable` |
| [Configuration Boundary](component-configuration.md) | Load, validate, and expose configuration through one explicit boundary rather than scattering environment and file access across domain code. | `stable` |
| [Data Access Boundary](component-data-access.md) | Isolate persistence protocols, queries, transactions, and mapping from domain decisions. | `stable` |
| [Structured Logging](component-logging.md) | Provide consistent structured events, context propagation, and redaction without coupling domain logic to one logging vendor. | `stable` |
| [Plugin System Boundary](component-plugin-system.md) | Support explicit extension points with versioned contracts, controlled discovery, isolation, and lifecycle management. | `stable` |
| [Retry and Backoff Policy](component-retry.md) | Centralise retry classification, bounded backoff, jitter, cancellation, and observability for transient failures. | `stable` |
| [Testing Utilities](component-testing-utilities.md) | Share deterministic fixtures, fakes, builders, clocks, and assertions that encode stable testing semantics rather than incidental implementation. | `stable` |
| [Validation Boundary](component-validation.md) | Convert untrusted or weakly typed input into validated domain values at system boundaries. | `stable` |
